scope: All four registered reward rules applied offline to the SAME fixed 16x8 baseline MONITOR blocks. Not realised trained-model credit or a training intervention; PART is not computed.
blocks_definition: protocol evaluation_slots sorts MONITOR qids lexically; index//16. Population std/covariance over eight draws within prompt.
W_definition: sum(max(+/-advantage,0)*event) over all4096 trajectories; totals divided by4096 give per-trajectory credit. Event counts retained.

DEC.scale_definition: weight/((per-prompt population std+EPS)*(full128 pre-advantage std+EPS)); 0 for constant component; EPS=1e-8
